description: BackupSpec defines the desired state of a Backup.

clusterRef.description: ClusterRef is the name of the Cluster in the same namespace.

destination.description: Destination defines where backups are stored.

bucketId.description:
BucketID is the namespace prefix for backup files.
Defaults to the cluster-id if not set.

driver.description: Driver is the backup storage driver: "s3".

bucket.description: Bucket is the S3 bucket name.

endpoint.description: Endpoint is a custom S3 endpoint (for MinIO).

s3AccessKeyId.description:
S3AccessKeyID is a static AWS access key ID for S3 authentication.
If not set, the default AWS credential chain is used (env vars, IRSA, etc.).

s3SecretAccessKey.description:
S3SecretAccessKey is a static AWS secret access key for S3 authentication.
If not set, the default AWS credential chain is used.

failedRunsHistoryLimit.description:
FailedRunsHistoryLimit is the maximum number of failed BackupRun
resources to keep per type (full/incremental). Older runs are garbage-collected.
Defaults to 1.

schedule.description:
Schedule defines cron schedules for full and incremental backups.
Both entries are optional; a Backup without any schedule is valid
and acts as a backup configuration template for manual BackupRun resources.

full.description: Full is the cron expression for full backups (e.g. "0 2 * * 0" for weekly Sunday 2am).

incremental.description: Incremental is the cron expression for incremental backups (e.g. "0 * * * *" for hourly).

successfulRunsHistoryLimit.description:
SuccessfulRunsHistoryLimit is the maximum number of successful BackupRun
resources to keep per type (full/incremental). Older runs are garbage-collected.
Defaults to 3.

timeout.description:
Timeout caps how long the `ledgerctl store backup` /
`ledgerctl store incremental-backup` RPC may run before the client
aborts. The operator forwards it as `--timeout` to the Job's
ledgerctl invocation; tune it for the size of the ledger and the
throughput of the destination bucket. Defaults to 1h, which is
enough for tens of GB on S3 while still bounding stuck runs.
